data_classification: synthetic demonstration only; property-level aggregates, no guest data or guest identifiers, no real hotel, channel or competitor rates

grains.RAW.PROPERTY_DAILY: one row per property per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.CHANNEL_CONNECTIONS: one row per property (distribution channel snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day FORECAST of new bookings; rate sync lag ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.PROPERTY_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic rate parity SOPs (one per property type and breach driver)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.REVENUE_MGMT_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.REVENUE_MGMT_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, property, breach-driver and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (properties, daily bookings and parity alerts, confirmed parity breaches by property, breach risk, rate-shop events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_RATE_SHOPS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_RATE_SHOPS_ALERT logs new ALERT events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
required_capabilities.breach_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(confirmed rate parity breach in next 7 days) per property, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout; operational, not pricing advice
